entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had been invited to an exclusive..."
entries.dialogueText: I had been invited to an exclusive preview of Alfred Kcirbuk's new film, "The Morning Shall Come".

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With its massive budget and Kcirbuk..."
entries.dialogueText: With its massive budget and Kcirbuk's directorial cachet, this drama was set to be a milestone for Sordland's burgeoning film scene. Personally, though, I was just looking forward to spending some time with my family.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was a very hot and sunny day as..."
entries.dialogueText: It was a very hot and sunny day as Serge drove us to the old capital. The film was to be screened in the historic Cinema Anglei dei Erlory -- the very first cinema in Sordland.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge had maxed out the air conditi..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge had maxed out the air conditioning to keep the Kadilla comfortable. I kept silent through most of our ride on the H-1. I couldn't get my mind off the results of the Assembly vote.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I gazed at the vast plains between..."
entries.dialogueText: I gazed at the vast plains between Holsord and Erlory as we drove on the H-1. Serge had maxed out the air conditioning to keep the Kadilla comfortable.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Look what you've done, Deana...""
entries.dialogueText: "Look what you've done, Deana..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Deana looked down."
entries.dialogueText: Deana looked down.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Anton! For God's sake!""
entries.dialogueText: "Anton! For God's sake!"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""If you were going to bring your wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you were going to bring your work stress into this, you shouldn't have taken us along."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""If you were going to bring your wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you were going to bring your work stress into this, you shouldn't have taken us along."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""All she wanted to do was cheer you..."
entries.dialogueText: "All she wanted to do was cheer you up."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""True. Next time you'll stay home.""
entries.dialogueText: "True. Next time you'll stay home."
entries.menuText: "True. Next time you'll stay home."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I know, I know. I didn't mean to m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know, I know. I didn't mean to make her sad..."
entries.menuText: "I know, I know. I didn't mean to make her sad..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You are right. I'm sorry for lashi..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are right. I'm sorry for lashing out."
entries.menuText: "You are right. I am sorry..."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Not again...""
entries.dialogueText: "Not again..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Besides which, Petr had worked hard..."
entries.dialogueText: Besides which, Petr had worked hard with the producers to make this screening possible during the emergency, albeit with limited attendance and heavy security.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge rolled down the soundproof gl..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge rolled down the soundproof glass between us.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Relax! I was just joking...""
entries.dialogueText: "Relax! I was just joking..."
entries.menuText: "Relax! I was just joking..."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""How very presidential of you, maki..."
entries.dialogueText: "How very presidential of you, making decisions on behalf of the rest of us."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Just watch your tone with the kids..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just watch your tone with the kids, Anton. Please control your stress."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Really? You were *joking*?""
entries.dialogueText: "Really? You were *joking*?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""It's okay. But please watch your t..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's okay. But please watch your tone with the kids, Anton."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc turned toward us for the firs..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc turned toward us for the first time since he'd gotten in the car.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""Sir, we are about to enter Erlory...."
entries.dialogueText: "Sir, we are about to enter Erlory. We'll be at the cinema in a few minutes."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you, Serge.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Serge."
entries.menuText: "Thank you, Serge."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Finally.""
entries.dialogueText: "Finally."
entries.menuText: "Finally."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Good. Thanks for telling me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good. Thanks for telling me."
entries.menuText: "Good. Thanks for telling me."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""Is there something wrong, sir?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is there something wrong, sir?"

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""My dad's just sick of us, Serge.""
entries.dialogueText: "My dad's just sick of us, Serge."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a brief look outside as Serg..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a brief look outside as Serge rolled the soundproof glass up again.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could see the many towers of Erlo..."
entries.dialogueText: I could see the many towers of Erlory rising over what was left of the old city walls.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I could see the many towers of Erlo..."
entries.dialogueText: I could see the many towers of Erlory rising over what was left of the old city walls.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the distance, there were several..."
entries.dialogueText: In the distance, there were several planes flying towards the city.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As they got closer to us, I saw tha..."
entries.dialogueText: As they got closer to us, I saw that they were military planes that looked like the sharp-edged Arcasian designs. They were probably headed for our new joint military base.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""Hah, young sir, don't say that. Wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hah, young sir, don't say that. Why would Mr. President get sick of you? He loves you all more than anything."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't mind him, Serge.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't mind him, Serge."
entries.menuText: "Don't mind him, Serge."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Franc, enough. Could you roll the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Franc, enough. Could you roll the glass up again, Serge?"
entries.menuText: "Franc, enough. Could you roll the glass up again, Serge?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Serge is right.""
entries.dialogueText: "Serge is right."
entries.menuText: "Serge is right."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""Of course, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, sir."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""Oh, sir, I don't mind the young mi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, sir, I don't mind the young mister. He's an intelligent young man."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""It's true!""
entries.dialogueText: "It's true!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc rolled his eyes."
entries.dialogueText: Franc rolled his eyes.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Wasn't your vineyard around here?""
entries.dialogueText: "Wasn't your vineyard around here?"

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""At any rate, we'll be there in a m..."
entries.dialogueText: "At any rate, we'll be there in a minute. I'll leave you to it for now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica pointed at the hills on the..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica pointed at the hills on the outskirts of the city.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's not mine. It's ours.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's not mine. It's ours."
entries.menuText: "It's not mine. It's ours."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's just behind those hills. We s..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's just behind those hills. We should go there sometime."
entries.menuText: "It's just behind those hills. We should go there sometime."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. It's already started producin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. It's already started producing wine again, too. We'll have our own wine soon!"
entries.menuText: "Yes. It's already started producing wine again, too. We'll have our own wine soon!"

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Rayne Wines! Made by a family who..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rayne Wines! Made by a family who knows nothing about making wine!"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""That would be lovely.""
entries.dialogueText: "That would be lovely."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She did not respond."
entries.dialogueText: She did not respond.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Speak for yourself, Franc.""
entries.dialogueText: "Speak for yourself, Franc."
entries.menuText: "Speak for yourself, Franc."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Doesn't sound half bad, actually.""
entries.dialogueText: "Doesn't sound half bad, actually."
entries.menuText: "Doesn't sound half bad, actually."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We're not the ones making the wine..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're not the ones making the wine, genius."
entries.menuText: "We're not the ones making the wine, genius."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""I know. Why lie? The truth always..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know. Why lie? The truth always sounds better anyway."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I meant 'Rayne Wines,' but sure.""
entries.dialogueText: "I meant 'Rayne Wines,' but sure."
entries.menuText: "I meant 'Rayne Wines,' but sure."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Are you sure about that, son? Trut..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sure about that, son? Truth doesn't really sell."
entries.menuText: "Are you sure about that, son? Truth doesn't really sell."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Okay, Franc...""
entries.dialogueText: "Okay, Franc..."
entries.menuText: "Okay, Franc..."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Yeah, okay. I know that my grandfa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yeah, okay. I know that my grandfather used to be a wine connoisseur or something. But did you really learn how to make wine?"

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""I'm sorry. I guess you know everyt..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry. I guess you know everything, dad."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""If only everyone thought like that..."
entries.dialogueText: "If only everyone thought like that, son..."
entries.menuText: "If only everyone thought like that, son..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge knocked on the glass and gest..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge knocked on the glass and gestured forwards.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She did not respond."
entries.dialogueText: She did not respond.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We were at the main square of Erlor..."
entries.dialogueText: We were at the main square of Erlory, and the historic 'Cinema Anglei'—the Cinema of Angels—was right in front of us.

entries.speaker: Deana
entries.title: Deana: ""Is this the place?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is this the place?"

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Yeah.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yeah."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc fidgeted with his tie as he s..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc fidgeted with his tie as he stared out the window.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Come on. Let's get out.""
entries.dialogueText: "Come on. Let's get out."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was an old baroque-style corner..."
entries.dialogueText: It was an old baroque-style corner building with walls that looked like marble from a distance. There were exquisite ornaments on each side of every window.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge pulled the car to the entranc..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge pulled the car to the entrance of the building, which was lit by vivid neon stripes in many colors.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge opened the doors, and we exit..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge opened the doors, and we exited onto the red carpet.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In contrast with the cinema's baroq..."
entries.dialogueText: In contrast with the cinema's baroque-style exterior, the inside was modern and sleek, with bare walls painted in black, red and white.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The film's cast and crew were alrea..."
entries.dialogueText: The film's cast and crew were already in the foyer, with glasses of champagne in their hands.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge opened the doors, and we exit..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge opened the doors, and we exited onto the red carpet.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As they noticed us and our many gua..."
entries.dialogueText: As they noticed us and our many guards, the mood in the room immediately soured.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We approached the crowd and were we..."
entries.dialogueText: We approached the crowd and were welcomed by the producers and the event organizers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On the wall next to the entrance, t..."
entries.dialogueText: On the wall next to the entrance, there were painted the words "Stop The Oppression of Bluds".

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On the wall next to the entrance, t..."
entries.dialogueText: On the wall next to the entrance, there were painted the words "Stop The Oppression of Bluds".

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Other graffiti next to it read, "St..."
entries.dialogueText: Other graffiti next to it read, "Stop the Genocide in Wehlen" and "Axis of Evil: Smolak, Rayne, Lancea."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As the police escorted us inside th..."
entries.dialogueText: As the police escorted us inside the cinema, a journalist broke through our security cordon and started running at me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As soon as he yelled "Mr. President..."
entries.dialogueText: As soon as he yelled "Mr. President!" one of the policemen kicked him in the back and forced him down onto the ground. Another grabbed me by the suit jacket and quickly ushered me away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He motioned for me and my family to..."
entries.dialogueText: He motioned for me and my family to continue along the security corridor.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Was that strictly necessary?""
entries.dialogueText: "Was that strictly necessary?"
entries.menuText: "Was that strictly necessary?"

entries.speaker: Policeman
entries.title: Policeman: ""Excuse us, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Excuse us, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I followed along, silently."
entries.dialogueText: I followed along, silently.
entries.menuText: Follow along.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't touch me again.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't touch me again."
entries.menuText: "Don't touch me again."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A man walked up to us with quick st..."
entries.dialogueText: A man walked up to us with quick steps.

entries.speaker: Policeman
entries.title: Policeman: ""Everything is for your safety, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Everything is for your safety, sir."

entries.speaker: Policeman
entries.title: Policeman: ""We had to for your safety, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "We had to for your safety, sir."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He and the other guards seemed not..."
entries.dialogueText: He and the other guards seemed not to care what had just happened. We kept walking through the corridor.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We were just about to enter the bui..."
entries.dialogueText: We were just about to enter the building when a journalist managed to block the path.

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""Mr. President! Mr. President!""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President! Mr. President!"

entries.speaker: Alfred Kcirbuk
entries.title: Alfred Kcirbuk: ""Madame! Mr. President! It's so goo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Madame! Mr. President! It's so good to see you here."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Why don't we take our seats? It's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why don't we take our seats? It's about to start."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gently bowed at Monica and shook..."
entries.dialogueText: He gently bowed at Monica and shook our hands.

entries.speaker: Alfred Kcirbuk
entries.title: Alfred Kcirbuk: ""It's an honor to meet you. I'm Alf..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's an honor to meet you. I'm Alfred Kcirbuk."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Nice to meet you, Mr. Kcirbuk.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nice to meet you, Mr. Kcirbuk."
entries.menuText: "Nice to meet you, Mr. Kcirbuk."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The honor is mine, Mr. Kcirbuk. I'..."
entries.dialogueText: "The honor is mine, Mr. Kcirbuk. I'm a big fan of your work."
entries.menuText: "The honor is mine, Mr. Kcirbuk. I'm a big fan of your work."

entries.speaker: Alfred Kcirbuk
entries.title: Alfred Kcirbuk: ""It's very humbling to know that yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's very humbling to know that you've been watching and enjoying my movies."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc snorted. I glanced at him, an..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc snorted. I glanced at him, and he innocently took a sip of his cola.

entries.speaker: Alfred Kcirbuk
entries.title: Alfred Kcirbuk: ""If you don't mind my asking, which..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you don't mind my asking, which one was your favorite? This one may be slightly different than my previous works."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I loved The Sordish Dream.""
entries.dialogueText: "I loved The Sordish Dream."
entries.menuText: "I loved The Sordish Dream."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""All of them are my favourites, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "All of them are my favourites, Mr. Kcirbuk."
entries.menuText: "All of them are my favourites, Mr. Kcirbuk."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I loved The Man Who Saved The Worl..."
entries.dialogueText: "I loved The Man Who Saved The World."
entries.menuText: "I loved The Man Who Saved The World."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stared at me for a while as if h..."
entries.dialogueText: He stared at me for a while as if he was trying to understand if I was joking or not.

entries.speaker: Alfred Kcirbuk
entries.title: Alfred Kcirbuk: ""You flatter me too much, Mr. Presi..."
entries.dialogueText: "You flatter me too much, Mr. President. I myself know they aren't all winners."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He laughed."
entries.dialogueText: He laughed.

entries.speaker: Alfred Kcirbuk
entries.title: Alfred Kcirbuk: ""Come now, just pick one!""
entries.dialogueText: "Come now, just pick one!"

entries.speaker: Alfred Kcirbuk
entries.title: Alfred Kcirbuk: ""That's by Mikel Vargas, Mr. Presid..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's by Mikel Vargas, Mr. President. It beat my film The Sordish Dream for the top prize at the Benfi Festival last year."

entries.speaker: Alfred Kcirbuk
entries.title: Alfred Kcirbuk: ""Oh, really? Then you might enjoy t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, really? Then you might enjoy this one too."

entries.speaker: Alfred Kcirbuk
entries.title: Alfred Kcirbuk: ""I'll admit, I didn't expect you to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll admit, I didn't expect you to be such a cinephile."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc looked me in the eye and stru..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc looked me in the eye and struggled not to laugh.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Although I wasn't in much of a movi..."
entries.dialogueText: Although I wasn't in much of a moviegoing mood, it would have been unpresidential not to attend.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Worried about the university exams..."
entries.dialogueText: "Worried about the university exams, son?"
entries.menuText: "Worried about the university exams, son?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What's wrong, Franc?""
entries.dialogueText: "What's wrong, Franc?"
entries.menuText: "What's wrong, Franc?"

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I ignored him and turned to Deana."
entries.dialogueText: I ignored him and turned to Deana.
entries.menuText: Ignore him and talk to Deana.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Since when do you care what's happ..."
entries.dialogueText: "Since when do you care what's happening in my life?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge had maxed out the air conditi..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge had maxed out the air conditioning to keep the Kadilla comfortable. But that wasn't the only reason I felt a chill in the air.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Never mind.""
entries.dialogueText: "Never mind."
entries.menuText: "Never mind."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I've been busy lately, but I'll al..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've been busy lately, but I'll always have time for you."
entries.menuText: "I've been busy lately, but I'll always have time for you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You know I'll support you whether..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know I'll support you whether you pass or fail those exams."
entries.menuText: "You know I'll support you whether you pass or fail those exams."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I noticed Franc fidgeting with his..."
entries.dialogueText: I noticed Franc fidgeting with his tie anxiously.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I turned to Deana."
entries.dialogueText: I turned to Deana.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Excited for the movie?""
entries.dialogueText: "Excited for the movie?"
entries.menuText: "Excited for the movie, sweetie?"

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Busy with failure?""
entries.dialogueText: "Busy with failure?"

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Franc, don't talk to your father t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Franc, don't talk to your father that way! He tried his best."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""What an honor, Your Highness.""
entries.dialogueText: "What an honor, Your Highness."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica suppressed a smirk."
entries.dialogueText: Monica suppressed a smirk.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""Franc, don't talk to your father t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Franc, don't talk to your father that way! He's been working so hard for this country."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Are you having a good time, sweeti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you having a good time, sweetie?"
entries.menuText: "Are you having a good time, sweetie?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Are you in a better mood than your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you in a better mood than your brother?"
entries.menuText: "Are you in a better mood than your brother?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Deana nodded shyly and hugged her s..."
entries.dialogueText: Deana nodded shyly and hugged her stuffed animal closer to her chest. Monica draped a protective arm around her. Nobody spoke for the rest of the ride.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Deana nodded happily."
entries.dialogueText: Deana nodded happily.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Hah! I won't lose. Isn't that righ..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hah! I won't lose. Isn't that right, Monica?"
entries.menuText: "Hah! I won't lose. Isn't that right, Monica?"

entries.speaker: Deana
entries.title: Deana: ""What about you, Papa? You won some..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about you, Papa? You won something, right? You should smile! And keep doing your best even if you lose."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm just fine, Deana. Everything's..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm just fine, Deana. Everything's going to be wonderful from now on, right, Monica?"
entries.menuText: "I'm just fine, Deana. Everything's going to be wonderful from now on, right, Monica?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""That's my girl. Thanks a lot.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's my girl. Thanks a lot."
entries.menuText: "That's my girl. Thanks a lot."

entries.speaker: Deana
entries.title: Deana: ""Don't worry about me, Papa! You've..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry about me, Papa! You've got the whole country to worry about!"

entries.speaker: Deana
entries.title: Deana: ""What about you, Papa? I know you'r..."
entries.dialogueText: "What about you, Papa? I know you're sad, but failure helps us grow, right?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Exactly! Now, where did you learn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly! Now, where did you learn that?"
entries.menuText: "Exactly! Now, where did you learn that?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""All I'm worried about is whether o..."
entries.dialogueText: "All I'm worried about is whether or not there will be popcorn."
entries.menuText: "All I'm worried about is whether or not there will be popcorn."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Ugh. Thanks for the reminder.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ugh. Thanks for the reminder."
entries.menuText: "Ugh. Thanks for the reminder."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""I wouldn't be so sure about that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't be so sure about that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I can handle Sordland without you,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can handle Sordland without you, old man."
entries.menuText: "I can handle Sordland without you, old man."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""Banning the Young Sords, while the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Banning the Young Sords, while the communists and Bludish scum run rampant?"

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""Why did you end the state of emerg..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why did you end the state of emergency so prematurely?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do you see me as your puppet?""
entries.dialogueText: "Do you see me as your puppet?"
entries.menuText: "Do you see me as your puppet?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I see.""
entries.dialogueText: "I see."
entries.menuText: "I see."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You could have spoken to me direct..."
entries.dialogueText: "You could have spoken to me directly."
entries.menuText: "You could have spoken to me about it directly."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The country still needs to be brou..."
entries.dialogueText: "The country still needs to be brought out of recession. This was a distraction."
entries.menuText: "The country still needs to be brought out of recession. This was a distraction."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I judged that the worst of the thr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I judged that the worst of the threat was over."
entries.menuText: "I judged that the worst of the threat was over."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It was reflecting badly on my repu..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was reflecting badly on my reputation as a democratic leader."
entries.menuText: "It was reflecting badly on my reputation as a democratic leader."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It was a hard decision, but I did..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was a hard decision, but I did what I had to."
entries.menuText: "It was a hard decision, but I did what I had to."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I wanted to stop the violence. The..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wanted to stop the violence. They were the worst offenders."
entries.menuText: "I wanted to stop the violence. They were the worst offenders."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""They had to be punished for Circas..."
entries.dialogueText: "They had to be punished for Circas' murder."
entries.menuText: "They had to be punished for Circas' murder."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""My decisions are not your business.""
entries.dialogueText: "My decisions are not your business."
entries.menuText: "My decisions are not your business."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""Your decision not to ban the Worke..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your decision not to ban the Workers Party of Bludia may cause problems, however. They clearly are a continuation of the Bludish Freedom Front."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""Your decision not to ban the Red Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your decision not to ban the Red Youth may cause problems, however."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""A ban will only lead to further vi..."
entries.dialogueText: "A ban will only lead to further violence."
entries.menuText: "A ban will only lead to further violence."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He heaved a sigh."
entries.dialogueText: He heaved a sigh.

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""Short-sighted. I tried to warn Haw..."
entries.dialogueText: "Short-sighted. I tried to warn Hawker about you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He raised his eyebrows."
entries.dialogueText: He raised his eyebrows.

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""Do you truly believe Hawker came t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you truly believe Hawker came to you of his own accord?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What do you mean?""
entries.dialogueText: "What do you mean?"
entries.menuText: "What do you mean?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Wait. The emergency declaration wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wait. The emergency declaration was your idea?"
entries.menuText: "Wait. The emergency declaration was your idea?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You spoke to Hawker?""
entries.dialogueText: "You spoke to Hawker?"
entries.menuText: "You spoke to Hawker?"

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""Don't be naive, Anton.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be naive, Anton."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""How do you think I've been spendin..."
entries.dialogueText: "How do you think I've been spending my retirement? Just tending to my garden in my island?"

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""I've got to protect my party and m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've got to protect my party and my legacy somehow. Hawker and Graf advise me on how."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""I told Hawker you could be counted..."
entries.dialogueText: "I told Hawker you could be counted on to make the right choice."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The police are doing enough to kee..."
entries.dialogueText: "The police are doing enough to keep the Bludish in line."
entries.menuText: "The police are doing enough to keep the Bludish in line."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The police are already doing enoug..."
entries.dialogueText: "The police are already doing enough to keep the communists in line."
entries.menuText: "The police are already doing enough to keep the communists in line."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The Bludish were your problem, not..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Bludish were your problem, not mine."
entries.menuText: "The Bludish were your problem, not mine."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The police are already doing enoug..."
entries.dialogueText: "The police are already doing enough to keep the communists in line."
entries.menuText: "The communists were your problem, not mine."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He raised his eyebrows."
entries.dialogueText: He raised his eyebrows.

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""Our problems are one and the same...."
entries.dialogueText: "Our problems are one and the same. Do you truly believe Hawker came to you of his own accord?"

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""And what good would that have done..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what good would that have done? You haven't trusted me since the Party Congress."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I always looked up to you. Just gi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I always looked up to you. Just give me a chance to do my job."
entries.menuText: "I've always looked up to you. Just give me a chance to do my job."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""You have no idea what it takes to..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have no idea what it takes to do this job, boy. But you'll find out soon enough."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He slipped past me and out the door..."
entries.dialogueText: He slipped past me and out the door.

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""I'm happy to hear that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm happy to hear that."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""Next time, perhaps I will.""
entries.dialogueText: "Next time, perhaps I will."

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""I see you as a novice in need of s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see you as a novice in need of some valuable guidance."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You can trust me.""
entries.dialogueText: "You can trust me."
entries.menuText: "You can trust me."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You had your chance to lead. Every..."
entries.dialogueText: "You had your chance to lead. Everyone saw what a mess you made."
entries.menuText: "You had your chance to lead. Everyone saw what a mess you made."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm warning you, sir. Stay out of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm warning you, sir. Stay out of my presidency.
entries.menuText: "I'm warning you, sir. Stay out of my presidency."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Soll fixed me with a piercing stare..."
entries.dialogueText: Soll fixed me with a piercing stare. He was an old man now -- how could he still be so intimidating?

entries.speaker: Tarquin Soll
entries.title: Tarquin Soll: ""Tread carefully, Mr. Rayne.""
entries.dialogueText: "Tread carefully, Mr. Rayne."

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""Your constitutional reforms made i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your constitutional reforms made it through the Assembly -- how do you feel about their chances with the Supreme Court?"

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""How are you handling the defeat of..."
entries.dialogueText: "How are you handling the defeat of your constitutional reforms in the Assembly?"

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""Thank you, Mr. President. And were..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mr. President. And were you aware that Tarquin Soll would be present at the proceedings?"

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""You recently rescinded your emerge..."
entries.dialogueText: "You recently rescinded your emergency declaration. Do you feel that the state has achieved its goals?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes, the threats to the nation hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, the threats to the nation have been neutralized."
entries.menuText: "Yes, the threats to the nation have been neutralized."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Our enemies are still out there. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our enemies are still out there. But we cannot keep living in fear."
entries.menuText: "Our enemies are still out there. But we cannot keep living in fear."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Declaring the emergency was a mist..."
entries.dialogueText: "Declaring the emergency was a mistake. The country's back on the right path now."
entries.menuText: "Declaring the emergency was a mistake. The country's back on the right path now."

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""One more question. Can you comment..."
entries.dialogueText: "One more question. Can you comment on the arrests of Marcel Koronti and Walter Tusk following the state takeovers of their companies?"

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""One more question. Can you comment..."
entries.dialogueText: "One more question. Can you comment on the arrest of Marcel Koronti following the state takeover of his corporation?"

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""One more question. Can you comment..."
entries.dialogueText: "One more question. Can you comment on the arrest of Walter Tusk following the state takeover of his corporation?"

entries.speaker: Reporter
entries.title: Reporter: ""One more question...""
entries.dialogueText: "One more question..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""He got in my way.""
entries.dialogueText: "He got in my way."
entries.menuText: "He got in my way."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""An unfortunate casualty, but natio..."
entries.dialogueText: "An unfortunate casualty, but nationalization is the only way forward."
entries.menuText: "An unfortunate casualty, but nationalization is the only way forward."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No, I have no comment.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, I have no comment."
entries.menuText: "No, I have no comment."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""They got in my way.""
entries.dialogueText: "They got in my way."
entries.menuText: "They got in my way."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""He got in my way.""
entries.dialogueText: "He got in my way."
entries.menuText: "He got in my way."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm going to keep fighting for my..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm going to keep fighting for my changes. This isn't over yet."
entries.menuText: "I'm going to keep fighting for my changes. This isn't over yet."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will respect the Assembly's deci..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will respect the Assembly's decision."
entries.menuText: "I will respect the Assembly's decision."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Not very well, to be honest.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not very well, to be honest."
entries.menuText: "Not very well, to be honest."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Of course I was.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course I was."
entries.menuText: "Of course I was."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No, I had to find out from my driv..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, I had to find out from my driver."
entries.menuText: "No, I had to find out from my driver."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I refuse to discuss Colonel Soll a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I refuse to discuss Colonel Soll at this time."
entries.menuText: "I refuse to discuss Colonel Soll at this time."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I trust the justices will make the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust the justices will make the right decision."
entries.menuText: "I trust the justices will make the right decision."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The court will vote my way if they..."
entries.dialogueText: "The court will vote my way if they know what's good for them."
entries.menuText: "The court will vote my way if they know what's good for them."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""One way or another, these reforms..."
entries.dialogueText: "One way or another, these reforms will pass."
entries.menuText: "One way or another, these reforms will pass."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before she could ask anything else,..."
entries.dialogueText: Before she could ask anything else, the guards ushered us inside the theater.

entries.dialogueText: Franc turned his head away to look outside the window.
